summary: Ran the pre-scheduled pre-close check (15:52 ET) because my stops are close-based and only actionable in the last half hour: SPY 767.75, RSP 220.16, IJH 77.38, IWM 300.55 — all 2.2-2.7% above their triggers, no guardrail breach (gross 94.3%, max position 24.2%), so no orders. Post-mortemed this morning's read: I called today 'positive breadth' off RSP outperforming, but RSP rose on a large-cap defensive rotation while my actual size bet (IJH -77bps, IWM -53bps vs SPY) disagreed all session — confirmation by instrument selection, and the tilt cost 18bps of bankroll today. That reading is noise against 51bps/day residual sd, so rule 7 says hold and I held. Stop redesign stayed deferred: its gate requires SPY within 0.5% of unchanged and SPY closed -0.64%, plus edits on red days are void.
